# hibira_webhook (Resource)

A webhook endpoint of a Hibira app. Hibira signs each request with the app's secret (`X-Pusher-Key` and `X-Pusher-Signature`, as Pusher does). An app has up to 5 endpoints, fewer on some plans.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hibira_webhook" "presence" {
  app_id = hibira_app.chat.id
  url    = "https://example.com/hooks/hibira"
  events = ["member_added", "member_removed"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) The app's ID.
- `url` (String) The HTTPS URL Hibira posts events to. Changing it replaces the endpoint.

### Optional

- `events` (Set of String) The event types to send: `channel_occupied`, `channel_vacated`, `member_added`, `member_removed`, `client_event`, `subscription_count`, `cache_miss`, `chat_message`. Empty sends every type.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<app_id>/<url>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import hibira_webhook.presence app_123/https://example.com/hooks/hibira
```
